row:
The West Coast Veterinary Hospital is a large clinic in Perth, Western Australia. We treat all species of animals - including dogs, cats, horses and farm animals.

We are a family run clinic and feel very humble to be able to offer all our clients personalised and passionate veterinary care. 

The intent of this Channel is to offer interesting, hilarious, and educational videos relating to veterinary care. We hope you enjoy watching.

Garnett & Max
